When the job was completed to his liking, he thrust the pipe between his lips, flicked a loose flake from his tunic, and forgot to apply a match. Instead, he picked up the envelope and examined it on all sides. Mahon began to grow impatient.

34556-phylogeny-of-the-waxwings-and-alli.creator: Unknown
34556-phylogeny-of-the-waxwings-and-alli.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. sult of inheritance from ancient ancestral stocks, which were in the distant past morphologically different. On the basis of this information, an attempt is made to ascertain the natural relationships of these birds. Previous workers have assigned waxwings alone to the family Bombycillidae, and a question to be determined in the present study is whether or not additional kinds of birds should be included in the family.

arxiv-2112-03383.title: Graph Neural Networks Accelerated Molecular Dynamics
arxiv-2112-03383.creator: Zijie Li, Kazem Meidani, Prakarsh Yadav, Amir Barati Farimani
arxiv-2112-03383.description: Abstract Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulation is a powerful tool for understanding the dynamics and structure of matter. Since the resolution of MD is atomic-scale, achieving long time-scale simulations with femtosecond integration is very expensive. In each MD step, numerous iterative computations are performed to calculate energy based on different types of interaction and their corresponding spatial gradients.

arxiv-2201-08954.title: Change Detection from Synthetic Aperture Radar Images via Graph-Based Knowledge Supplement Network Thanks: This work was supported in part by the National Key Research and Development Program of China under Grant 2018AAA0100602, in part by the Key Research and Development Program of Shandong Provinc
arxiv-2201-08954.creator: Junjie Wang, Feng Gao Member, IEEE, Junyu Dong, Member, IEEE
arxiv-2201-08954.description: Abstract Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) image change detection is a vital yet challenging task in the field of remote sensing image analysis. Most previous works adopt a self-supervised method which uses pseudo-labeled samples to guide subsequent training and testing. However, deep networks commonly require many high-quality samples for parameter optimization.

arxiv-2203-15510.title: Achieving Guidance in Applied Machine Learning through Software Engineering Techniques Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3397537.3397552 prog20eniac-id3-p ISBN: 978-1-4503-7507-8/20/03 Conference: Companion Proceedings of the 4th International Conference on the Art, Science, and Engineering of Programming;
arxiv-2203-15510.creator: Lars Reimann, Günter Kniesel-Wünsche
arxiv-2203-15510.description: Abstract . Development of machine learning (ML) applications is hard. Producing successful applications requires, among others, being deeply familiar with a variety of complex and quickly evolving application programming interfaces (APIs). It is therefore critical to understand what prevents developers from learning these APIs, using them properly at development time, and understanding what went wrong when it comes to debugging.

arxiv-2206-08085.creator: Long Zhang 1, Hai-Ping Cheng 1
arxiv-2206-08085.description: Abstract We present first-principle calculation of the on-site and nearest neighbor Coulomb interaction strength of the Ni d d orbitals in bulk L ​ a ​ N ​ i ​ O 2 LaNiO_{2} , using the constrained Random Phase Approximation method.

arxiv-2308-13608.title: Generalized stability conditions for binary bose mixtures
arxiv-2308-13608.creator: M. Benarous, A. Hocine, A. Mehedi
arxiv-2308-13608.description: Abstract Considering both interspecies and intraspecies fluctuations in ultracold bose-bose mixtures, we derive generalized stability conditions against collapse and phase separation. Furthermore, by examining the energy density of the system, we show that new LHY-like effects may enforce or destroy the stability according to the excitation branch, therefore, permitting or prohibiting the existence of droplet states. PACS: 05.30.Jp, 11.15.Tk, 32.80.

pmc-10689677.creator: Yannik Schälte, Fabian Fröhlich, Paul J Jost, Jakob Vanhoefer, Dilan Pathirana, Paul Stapor, Polina Lakrisenko, Dantong Wang, Elba Raimúndez, Simon Merkt, Leonard Schmiester, Philipp Städter, Stephan Grein, Erika Dudkin, Domagoj Doresic, Daniel Weindl, Jan Hasenauer, Anthony Mathelier
pmc-10689677.description: SummaryMechanistic models are important tools to describe and understand biological processes. However, they typically rely on unknown parameters, the estimation of which can be challenging for large and complex systems. pyPESTO is a modular framework for systematic parameter estimation, with scalable algorithms for optimization and uncertainty quantification.

pmc-11492137.title: Physical exercise improved the hematological effect of vitamin D in type 2 diabetes mellitus-induced nephrotoxicity in rats
pmc-11492137.creator: Halimat Amin Abdulrahim, Adeyemi Fatai Odetayo, Adeoye Tunwagun David, Yusuf Funsho Abdulquadri, Rofiat Oluwasheun Sheu, Pelumi Kikelomo Oluwafemi, Kazeem Bidemi Okesina, Luqman Aribidesi Olayaki
pmc-11492137.description: IntroductionGlobally, one of the major causes of renal dysfunction is diabetes mellitus (DM), and diabetic-induced nephrotoxicity has been linked with anemia. Presently, numerous antidiabetic drugs have been designed for the management of this disorder but they possess their undesirable effects such as anemia and acute kidney injury.

pmc-11512228.title: Shared Accountability Shaping the Destinies of Individual and Groups of Nonhuman Primates
pmc-11512228.creator: Ori Pomerantz, Gregory Brion Timmel, Steven J Schapiro, Elizabeth R Magden
pmc-11512228.description: Simple SummaryAt the California National Primate Research Center (CNPRC), rhesus macaques are kept in large, complex social groups outdoors because this environment helps them behave naturally and cope well. However, living in groups can lead to problems, such as fights that sometimes result in injuries.

pmc-11675851.title: Entropy as a Tool for the Analysis of Stock Market Efficiency During Periods of Crisis
pmc-11675851.creator: Daniel Papla, Rafał Siedlecki, Nikolay Kolev Vitanov, Joanna Olbryś
pmc-11675851.description: In the article, we analyse the problem of the efficiency market hypothesis using entropy in moments of transition from a normal economic situation to crises or slowdowns in European, Asian and US stock markets and the economy in the years 2007–2023 (2008–2009, U.S. financial sector crises; 2020–2021, Pandemic period; and the 2022–2023 period of Russia’s attack on Ukraine).

pmc-12632105.title: Response of soil nematode communities in Stipa baicalensis meadow steppe to mowing frequencies
pmc-12632105.creator: Renheng Wu, Zhendan Wu, Yaling Zhang, He Ye, Dianlin Yang, Mei Hong
pmc-12632105.description: Soil nematodes are essential indicator of organisms for assessing the health of grassland ecosystems, and their community structure is sensitive to changes in grassland utilization practices. However, there is still a lack of research on how long different mowing frequencies affect the characteristics of soil nematode communities.

pmc-13138293.title: Contralateral screw loosening of through-and-through fixation following unilateral sacroiliac joint fusion: illustrative case
pmc-13138293.creator: Rafael Garcia, Cale Hendricks, David W Polly
pmc-13138293.description: BACKGROUNDSacroiliac (SI) joint dysfunction is a frequently underrecognized source of low back pain, implicated in 15%–30% of cases across select populations. Unilateral SI joint fusion remains the most commonly performed technique, utilizing either iliosacral screws or, more recently, through-and-through (TNT) screws.

pmc-13418458.creator: Chail Shah, Rakesh Shetty Rajalbandi, Vikram Seshadri, Alvin Chandra, Oluseyi Abidoye, Joshua Battley
pmc-13418458.description: BackgroundImmune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) are increasingly used as first-line therapy for various malignancies and are associated with a growing spectrum of immune-related adverse events. While many toxicities are managed in the outpatient setting, a clinically significant subset progresses to life-threatening multisystem disease requiring intensive care.

pmc-13578288.title: Emotion regulation strategy use and daily levels of affective arousal, affective valence and dissociation in a clinical sample
pmc-13578288.creator: Martin Tegtmeyer, James J Gross, David A Preece, Johannes B Heekerens
pmc-13578288.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Clinical models and cross-sectional research suggest that habitual use of disengagement-oriented emotion regulation strategies is associated with high levels of affective arousal, negative valence, and dissociation, whereas engagement-oriented strategies show the opposite effect. However, intensive longitudinal evidence remains scarce. This study examined whether habitual use of 10 emotion regulation strategies, assessed using the Process Model of Emotion Regulation Questionnaire (PMERQ), predicts affective arousal and valence, and dissociation in daily life.
